notes_for_editor: The 1938 build, the 1966 sale and the move to Cloverleaf are well sourced by the county report. No date for the move, no staffing and no owner name were found. The 1966 'Footings remain at site' line sits in the row for the 1938 tower (Waskish 85), so it is read as the original Waskish site. The 1966 'Replaced the tower noted above' line in that row ties the 1938 tower to the earlier Waskish tower, which the 1954 note in the first Waskish row says was moved. Cloverleaf is covered by us-mn-waskish-at-cloverleaf. The FFLA also lists a standing 'Big Bog (Relocated Pine Island)' at 48.17012, -94.51192, roughly 250 m from this record's coordinates; no source read links it to Waskish, so the story does not mention it.
